verdict.rationale: Elastic's logs docs say users can 'detect patterns and outliers with categorization and anomaly detection', which is first-party evidence of threshold-free outlier surfacing. The evidence is a single thin mention scoped to logs, and the alerting evidence shown is threshold-based. missing for 10: documentation on enabling or configuring anomaly detection jobs, anomaly-based alerting rules, coverage beyond logs (metrics, APM), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can enable anomaly or outlier detection that surfaces problems without hand-written thresholds

citations.quote: detect patterns and outliers with categorization and anomaly detection
